cliente_que_paga: Controls engineers / integrators with TIA Portal and Studio 5000
problema: Siemens SCL/ladder sources cannot be diffed natively; code review of PLC changes is manual.
solucion: Web app that ingests exported XML/L5X and shows readable diffs and change reports, with a git-friendly CLI.
canal_primeros_100: Search 'compare TIA Portal projects' / 'L5X diff' plus PLCTalk and r/PLC posts
por_que_ahora: IEC 61131 teams adopting git/CI; Siemens VCI exports XML since V16.
ventaja_juan: Knows TIA Portal and Studio 5000 export formats.
riesgo_principal: Vendors may ship better native diffs.

problema: Customers demand I/O lists and tag docs; engineers write them by hand.

canal_primeros_100: SEO 'Studio 5000 I/O list generator' and PLCTalk forum
por_que_ahora: Integrators have less time per project and handoff docs are contractually required.

problema: Customer-uploaded STEP files arrive broken, with units wrong or no solids.

por_que_ahora: Cheap CNC machines are widespread among small shops.
riesgo_principal: Free viewers satisfy many users (F1 risk).
